title: About Fix It Notes
meta: About Fix It Notes: who runs this DIY home repair site, how guides are researched, and how the site is funded.
html:
What is this site?

Fix It Notes is a free library of plain-English DIY home repair guides, part of the samcbarth.com network run by Sam Barth. Each guide answers one common problem, lists the tools and materials, walks through the steps in order, and says plainly when a job belongs to a licensed professional.

How are guides researched?

Guides are written from manufacturer instructions (for example InSinkErator, Moen, Whirlpool, GE Appliances, Leviton and A. O. Smith), public safety agencies (CPSC, EPA, U.S. Department of Energy, U.S. Fire Administration, OSHA), safety organizations (NFPA, Electrical Safety Foundation International) and established home improvement publishers. Every guide links its sources so you can check them. We do not claim hands-on testing we have not done.

How is the site funded?

Some tool and material links are affiliate links. If you buy through them, the site may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. That never changes what a guide recommends. See the affiliate disclosure.

Corrections

If you spot an error or an outdated step, please let us know through the contact page. Safety corrections are fixed first.

title: Contact
meta: Contact Fix It Notes with corrections, guide requests or questions about the site.
html: Corrections, guide requests and questions about the site are welcome. We cannot diagnose specific repairs remotely; for anything involving gas, electrical panels, structural concerns or active leaks, contact a licensed local professional.

title: Privacy Policy
meta: Privacy policy for Fix It Notes (homerepair.samcbarth.com): cookies, analytics, advertising and affiliate links.
html:
Who we are

This site, homerepair.samcbarth.com, is operated by Sam Barth as part of the samcbarth.com network.

What we collect

We do not require accounts. If you contact us, we receive the information you choose to send, such as your name, email address and message, and use it only to reply.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Tag Manager and may use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site, such as which pages are viewed and how visitors arrive. These tools use cookies and similar technologies and collect information like your IP address, browser and device type. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and Google offers an opt-out browser add-on for Google Analytics.

Advertising

We may show ads served by Google and its partners. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visits. You can opt out of personalized advertising at Google's Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com) or at aboutads.info.

Affiliate links

Some links go to retailers such as Amazon. As an Amazon Associate we may earn from qualifying purchases. When you click an affiliate link, the retailer may set cookies to attribute the sale. We do not receive your payment details or order information that identifies you.

Forms

Contact forms may be provided by HubSpot. Information you submit is stored by HubSpot on our behalf and used only to respond to you.

Children

This site is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Your choices

You can ask us to delete information you sent us by contacting us through the contact page. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under privacy laws.

Changes

We may update this policy and will change the date at the bottom when we do.

title: Terms of Use
meta: Terms of use for Fix It Notes DIY home repair guides, including safety and liability notes.
html:
Information only

The guides on this site are general information, not professional advice. Homes, products and local codes vary. Always follow your product's instructions, local building and electrical codes, and permit requirements.

Your safety is your responsibility

Home repair involves risks including electric shock, gas leaks, falls, cuts and water damage. If you are unsure, stop and hire a licensed professional. Electrical, gas and structural work may legally require a licensed contractor in your area.

No warranty

We work to keep guides accurate and current, but we provide them as is, without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or injury arising from use of this site.

Third-party links

We link to manufacturers, agencies and retailers. We are not responsible for their content, prices or policies.

Content

Text on this site is original unless credited. You may link to and quote short excerpts with attribution.

Changes

We may update these terms; continued use means you accept the current version.

title: Affiliate Disclosure
meta: How Fix It Notes earns money from affiliate links, including the Amazon Associates program, and how that affects recommendations.
html:
How does this site make money?

Some links on Fix It Notes are affiliate links. If you click one and buy something, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Amazon Associates

As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases. Buttons that say "Check price on Amazon" lead to Amazon search results or product pages. We do not display Amazon prices or ratings on this site; check current prices and reviews on Amazon.

Does this affect recommendations?

No. Tools and materials are listed because a repair needs them, based on manufacturer instructions and safety guidance. We describe what to look for in a tool rather than claiming hands-on tests we have not done.

Where are affiliate links disclosed?

Every page with affiliate links carries a short disclosure above the first link, and this page explains the details.
